argv:
import platform, re, subprocess
L = open('.github/workflows/ci.yml', encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines()
Q = chr(34)
i = L.index('        include:')
rows, cur = [], None
for line in L[i + 1:]:
    m = re.fullmatch('          - os: ([^ ]+)', line)
    if m:
        cur = {'os': m.group(1)}; rows.append(cur); continue
    m = re.fullmatch('            python: ' + Q + '(3[.][0-9]+)' + Q, line)
    if m and cur is not None and 'python' not in cur:
        cur['python'] = m.group(1); continue
    break
assert sorted((r['os'], r.get('python')) for r in rows) == [('macos-latest', '3.14'), ('ubuntu-latest', '3.12'), ('ubuntu-latest', '3.14')], rows
need = ['  workflow_dispatch:', '  SHELLCHECK_VERSION: ' + Q + '0.11.0' + Q, '    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}', '      - uses: actions/checkout@v4', '          fetch-depth: 0', '      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5', '          python-version: ${{ matrix.python }}', '        run: python3 tests/test-evidence-2a.py', '        run: bash tests/run-tests.sh']
for n in need:
    assert L.count(n) == 1, n
assert '        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]' not in L
text = chr(10).join(L)
for n in ('shellcheck-v${SHELLCHECK_VERSION}.linux.x86_64.tar.xz', 'brew install shellcheck', 'sudo apt-get install -y tmux jq', 'brew install tmux jq', 'pip install jsonschema', 'import jsonschema', '. scripts/harness-path.sh', 'sys.version_info[:2]', '${{ matrix.python }}' + Q):
    assert n in text, n
at = lambda s: min(k for k, l in enumerate(L) if s in l)
assert at('actions/checkout@v4') < at('actions/setup-python@v5') < min(at('pip install jsonschema'), at('apt-get install -y tmux jq'), at('brew install tmux jq'), at('python3 tests/test-evidence-2a.py'), at('bash tests/run-tests.sh'))
H = open('tests/run-tests.sh', encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines()
hdr = [l for l in H[:20] if l.startswith('echo ' + Q + '== python ')]
assert hdr == ['echo ' + Q + '== python $(python3 -c ' + chr(39) + 'import platform; print(platform.python_version())' + chr(39) + ')' + Q], hdr
out = subprocess.run(['bash', '-c', hdr[0]], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
assert out == '== python ' + platform.python_version() + chr(10), out
print('ok')
